lines.1: 「Maybe it's because the Princess and Yoppi are here, but this student council room has a great atmosphere.」
lines.2: 「I keep telling you not to call me Yoppi.」
lines.5: 「Now, now. I brought a painting from home. Why don't we hang it here?」
lines.8: 「(Heh heh. This is a genuine masterpiece my old man paid a fortune for--a family treasure.)」
lines.9: 「(It's so valuable, I've been told that if the house catches fire, I should save it before myself.)」
lines.10: 「(It made quite an impression on me, too.)」
lines.11: 「(My parents will kill me if they find out, but who cares? This should raise her affection score through the roof.)」
lines.13: 「The woman painted here looks a little too fat. Obesity is dangerous, so shouldn't she lose some weight?」
lines.15: 「I have plans today, so I will be leaving first.」
lines.16: 「Okay. I'll stamp the approval seals too.」
lines.18: 「...And that is Ellie's opinion of the painting.」
lines.19: 「It is the famous Autumn Harvest Festival, isn't it? But I can never tell whether Ellie has no sense for art or simply has very unusual tastes.」
lines.21: 「She didn't mean anything bad by it, so please don't be upset.」
lines.22: 「Don't you go a little easy on the Princess, Yoppi?」
lines.23: 「Well, she's easy on everyone. No wonder she's Sato--sweet as sugar.」
lines.24: 「But that's what makes Yoppi so great.」
lines.25: 「Can we go home too? There's a live show at Dobuzaka this evening.」
lines.26: 「Sure. I can handle everything that's left.」
lines.27: 「That's our Yoppi! You get it. Later!」
lines.28: 「Are you sure? I could stay and help if you want.」
lines.29: 「Yeah, yeah. Stop trying so blatantly to score points. I can practically hear your inner monologue, and it's pathetic. Besides, weren't you supposed to treat us today?」
